_readme: What the extension process must actually SEE, as opposed to what a schema or the wrapper's source claims.
A schema diff proves a declared surface matches. It does not prove WebKit bound the namespace,
the permission gated it correctly, or the wrapper's additions reached the worker. The live reflection
suite (OrbitAppTests/WebKitExtensionRuntimeSurfaceReflectionLiveTests) loads a real MV3 fixture
declaring every permission Orbit supports, walks the `chrome` object inside its own service worker,
and checks the report against this file, against the wrapper inventory
mustBeDefined: namespaces an extension holding these permissions must be able to reach.
Wrapper-provided and WebKit-native namespaces are both listed; a missing one is a binding that never reached the worker.
knownUnavailable: namespaces nothing provides on WebKit, each with the reason. Asserted UNDEFINED, so the day one starts
working the test fails and the entry has to be deleted -- the same two-directional discipline as ExpectedAPIGaps.json.
Namespaces WebKit may or may not provide (extension, userScripts, browserAction) are deliberately not listed.
permissionGatedNamespaces: the negative control. With none of these permissions declared, each namespace must be undefined.
OrbitTests/ExtensionRuntimeSurfaceExpectationsTests checks every permission-gated namespace the wrapper creates has a row here.
partiallyGatedNamespaces: namespaces defined without their permission but with only the members upstream leaves ungated.

knownUnavailable.debugger: WebKit has no public remote debugging protocol an extension could drive.
knownUnavailable.pageCapture: WebKit can archive a page as .webarchive but has no MHTML writer.
knownUnavailable.processes: WebKit exposes no public per-renderer process information.
knownUnavailable.notifications: WKWebExtension.Permission has no notifications permission, so WebKit does not provide the API and Orbit has not built one.
knownUnavailable.sidePanel: WKWebExtension.Permission has no sidePanel permission and Orbit has no side panel host.
knownUnavailable.proxy: Neither WebKit nor the wrapper provides it; WKWebsiteDataStore proxy configuration could back it but Orbit has not built that.
knownUnavailable.identity: Not provided by WebKit and not built by Orbit; blocks every OAuth-backed extension.
knownUnavailable.tabGroups: WebKit has no tab groups API and Orbit does not map its own groups onto one.
knownUnavailable.topSites: Not provided by WebKit and not built by Orbit.
knownUnavailable.browsingData: Not provided by WebKit; WKWebsiteDataStore could back it but Orbit has not built that.
knownUnavailable.contentSettings: Not provided by WebKit; Orbit's site permissions are not exposed to extensions.
knownUnavailable.declarativeContent: Not provided by WebKit and not built by Orbit.
knownUnavailable.tabCapture: Not provided by WebKit and not built by Orbit.
knownUnavailable.desktopCapture: Not provided by WebKit and not built by Orbit.
knownUnavailable.fontSettings: Not provided by WebKit and not built by Orbit.
knownUnavailable.gcm: Needs Google's push service, which Orbit has no account or transport for.
knownUnavailable.instanceID: Needs Google's push service, which Orbit has no account or transport for.
knownUnavailable.omnibox: Not provided by WebKit and Orbit's command bar does not host extension keywords.
knownUnavailable.tts: Not provided by WebKit and not built by Orbit.
knownUnavailable.ttsEngine: Not provided by WebKit and not built by Orbit.
knownUnavailable.readingList: Not provided by WebKit and not built by Orbit.
knownUnavailable.webAuthenticationProxy: Not provided by WebKit and not built by Orbit.
knownUnavailable.accessibilityFeatures: Not provided by WebKit and not built by Orbit.

management.note: chrome.management is defined without its permission but keeps only its three members that need none. The control asserts that shape rather than absence, because the wrapper's ungated list is what makes getSelf work for an extension that never asked for management.
